description: This file is a shell script that sets up and tests Git repository behaviors related to shallow cloning and bitmap optimizations. It defines a test function 'test_shallow_bitmaps' that initializes a repository, performs shallow clone operations, configures bitmap settings, and verifies correct fetch behavior in shallow repositories.

methods.name: test_shallow_bitmaps
methods.description: Sets up a sequence of Git operations to test bitmap behavior with shallow repositories, including initialization, commits, cloning, configuration, and fetching.
